# Python

- Project: https://www.python.org
- **Not bundled:** Python is installed by uv on first use of a Python site into `data\runtimes\python\` (builds from the python-build-standalone project, https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone).
- License: **Python Software Foundation License** – https://docs.python.org/3/license.html
- The standalone builds contain further components (OpenSSL, SQLite, Tcl/Tk …) under their own licenses; see the license files inside each installed version.
